stage: built and rendered at 1440 and 390 px

choice-justified:directed-causal-flow.why: The question is causal: which failure came from which gap in AES and which fix closes it. Three columns with edges put each trace on the page; a fix that points at no gap, or a gap with no fix, shows as a missing edge.

rejected:state-machine-view.why: Router's top pick, but nothing here moves between states; state is one badge per fix unit.

rejected:staged-explanatory-machine.why: Scroll-staged reveal breaks the whole-on-one-screen read.

rejected:project-schedule.why: No dates or durations; order is given in the plan text instead of inventing a time axis.

accessibility: state carried by outline style plus a word and symbol (done solid blue fill, next orange dash-dot, planned grey dash, your pick heavy black); no red/green
mobile: under 760 px the graph becomes one card per failure listing its gaps and fixes; 390 px render has no horizontal scroll
wrong-if: Brian asks which fix comes first or when (then a schedule view was the job)
a fix unit has no edge to the gap it claims to close
Brian cannot tell next from planned in greyscale
router-gaps: primary scored state-machine-view for a causal failure-to-fix map with no transitions
